# Welcome {.unnumbered}

A prognostic meta-analysis pools studies that estimate how well a factor, or a whole model, predicts a future outcome. The question is not whether a treatment works. It is how much knowing something today changes what you should expect tomorrow.

::: {.callout-warning}
This book is a skeleton. The seven chapters carry their final structure, which
follows the class sequence exactly, and the prose is being written.
:::

## How this book is organised {.unnumbered .no-slide}

Seven chapters, in the order you would actually do the work:

| Chapter | Topic |
|---|---|
| 1 | What it is, goals and examples |
| 2 | Viability, search strategy and data extraction |
| 3 | Registering on PROSPERO |
| 4 | Statistics theory |
| 5 | Statistics code |
| 6 | Checklist |
| 7 | Writing and interpretation |

Each chapter is the written half of a class, and every second-level heading is
one slide, so the book and the deck cannot drift apart.
